verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say you can "watch spend in real time" on issued cards, and that receipts and categories are captured as soon as a card is swiped. Its site cites "real-time visibility into SaaS spend." Slicing by merchant, department, and category is supported through transaction search, vendor queries such as top vendors by spend, and admin spend analysis via MCP, with real-time sync to accounting. missing for 10: an explicitly documented dashboard or report breaking spend down by team/category/merchant, and independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day latency.
